package serial

import (
	"sync"

	"golang.org/x/sys/windows"
)

const (
	probePortHandle  windows.Handle = 400
	probeEventHandle windows.Handle = 401
)

var probeCalls struct {
	sync.Mutex
	submitted        windows.Handle
	waited           windows.Handle
	cancelled        windows.Handle
	closed           int
	waitComplete     bool
	closedBeforeWait bool
	beforeWait       chan struct{}
	resume           chan struct{}
}

func probeReset() {
	probeCalls.Lock()
	defer probeCalls.Unlock()
	probeCalls.submitted = 0
	probeCalls.waited = 0
	probeCalls.cancelled = 0
	probeCalls.closed = 0
	probeCalls.waitComplete = false
	probeCalls.closedBeforeWait = false
	probeCalls.beforeWait = make(chan struct{})
	probeCalls.resume = make(chan struct{})
}

func probeBeforeCompletion() {
	close(probeCalls.beforeWait)
	<-probeCalls.resume
}

func probeCreateFile(_ *uint16, _ uint32, _ uint32, _ *windows.SecurityAttributes, _ uint32, _ uint32, _ windows.Handle) (windows.Handle, error) {
	return probePortHandle, nil
}

func probeGetCommState(_ windows.Handle, _ *windows.DCB) error             { return nil }
func probeSetCommState(_ windows.Handle, _ *windows.DCB) error             { return nil }
func probeSetCommTimeouts(_ windows.Handle, _ *windows.CommTimeouts) error { return nil }

func probeCreateEvent(_ *windows.SecurityAttributes, _ uint32, _ uint32, _ *uint16) (windows.Handle, error) {
	return probeEventHandle, nil
}

func probeCloseHandle(handle windows.Handle) error {
	if handle == probePortHandle {
		probeCalls.Lock()
		probeCalls.closed++
		probeCalls.closedBeforeWait = !probeCalls.waitComplete
		probeCalls.Unlock()
	}
	return nil
}

func probeReadFile(handle windows.Handle, _ []byte, _ *uint32, _ *windows.Overlapped) error {
	probeCalls.Lock()
	probeCalls.submitted = handle
	probeCalls.Unlock()
	return windows.ERROR_IO_PENDING
}

func probeWriteFile(_ windows.Handle, _ []byte, _ *uint32, _ *windows.Overlapped) error {
	panic("unexpected WriteFile")
}

func probeGetOverlappedResult(handle windows.Handle, _ *windows.Overlapped, _ *uint32, _ bool) error {
	probeCalls.Lock()
	defer probeCalls.Unlock()
	probeCalls.waited = handle
	probeCalls.waitComplete = true
	if handle != probePortHandle {
		return windows.ERROR_INVALID_HANDLE
	}
	return windows.ERROR_OPERATION_ABORTED
}

func probeCancelIoEx(handle windows.Handle, _ *windows.Overlapped) error {
	probeCalls.Lock()
	probeCalls.cancelled = handle
	probeCalls.Unlock()
	return nil
}
